Part Of The Life

Everywhere you already love being.

Ridge hikes at golden hour. Black sand after a swim. Market mornings that start the week right. This is Hawaiʻi Island living — Meli Brew's already in it.

The Difference

Jun isn't kombucha's cousin. It's the original, done our way.

Most kombucha on the shelf is black tea and cane sugar fermented with a SCOBY. Jun swaps in loose-leaf green tea and raw honey — a slower, gentler ferment that a lot of brewers skip because it's harder to get right. We didn't skip it. It's the whole reason Meli Brew exists.

Our Story
"We weren't trying to build a beverage brand. We were trying to make the kombucha we wanted to drink — and share it with our island."

Meli Brew started as a family kitchen project on Hawaiʻi Island: raw local honey, loose-leaf green tea, and a lot of trial and error before the first batch tasted like paradise instead of vinegar. Our Paradise Passion flavor went on to take Best in Show at Kombucha Kon '22 in the Jun category — but the process hasn't changed. Small batches, real fruit, honey sourced from the island we live on.

— The Meli Brew ʻohana
